testdata/macro-if.asm:
    1                                           t1 macro arg 
    2                                            t2 arg
    3                                           endm 
    4                                           
    5                                           t2 macro arg
    6                                            t3 arg
    7                                           endm
    8                                           
    9                                           t3 macro arg
   10                                             t4 arg
   11                                           endm
   12                                           
   13                                           t4 macro arg
   14                                             if arg > 0
   15                                               ld a, arg
   16                                             else
   17                                               ld hl, arg
   18                                             endif
   19                                           endm
   20                                           
   21                                           t1 0
   21                                         +  t2 arg
   21                                         +  t3 arg
   21                                         +   t4 arg
   21  0000 21 00 00                 [10]     +     ld hl, arg
   21                                         + endm(T4)
   21                                         + endm(T3)
   21                                         + endm(T2)
   21                                         + endm(T1)
   22                                           t1 1
   22                                         +  t2 arg
   22                                         +  t3 arg
   22                                         +   t4 arg
   22  0003 3e 01                    [ 7]     +     ld a, arg
   22                                         + endm(T4)
   22                                         + endm(T3)
   22                                         + endm(T2)
   22                                         + endm(T1)
